e.title: Experience Rating in Insurance Pricing (Wüthrich)
e.summary: Wüthrich 经验费率讲义配套 R 代码（SSRN 4726206）：合成数据+神经网络权重，车险费率进阶
e.body: Experience-Rating-in-Insurance-Pricing 是 Wüthrich 同名讲义（SSRN 4726206）的配套 R 代码：经验费率（experience rating）在保险定价中的应用——含合成数据（DataSynthetic.rda）与涉及神经网络的示例权重。经验费率（用历史理赔经验调整费率）是车险定价进阶核心。与 [[aitools4actuaries]]（Wüthrich 等 AI 精算课程）、[[insurancerating]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Wüthrich 讲义《Experience Rating in Insurance Pricing》R 代码（SSRN 4726206），含合成数据与 NN 权重
e.summary_en: Companion R code of Wüthrich's lecture notes 'Experience Rating in Insurance Pricing' (SSRN 4726206): synthetic data + NN weights
e.summary_hk: Wüthrich 經驗費率講義配套 R 代碼（SSRN 4726206）：合成數據+神經網絡權重，車險費率進階
e.body_en: Experience-Rating-in-Insurance-Pricing is the companion R code of Wüthrich's lecture notes of the same name (SSRN 4726206): experience rating in insurance pricing — with synthetic data (DataSynthetic.rda) and network weights for the neural-network examples. Experience rating (adjusting premiums with claims experience) is core advanced motor pricing. Complements [[aitools4actuaries]] (Wüthrich et al. AI actuarial course), [[insurancerating]] and [[machine-learning-pricing]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[claim-frequency]].
e.body_hk: Experience-Rating-in-Insurance-Pricing 是 Wüthrich 同名講義（SSRN 4726206）的配套 R 代碼：經驗費率（experience rating）在保險定價中的應用——含合成數據（DataSynthetic.rda）與涉及神經網絡的示例權重。經驗費率（用歷史理賠經驗調整費率）是車險定價進階核心。與 [[aitools4actuaries]]（Wüthrich 等 AI 精算課程）、[[insurancerating]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
